messages:
olivia_csm: Quick heads-up — we have an ingestion delay affecting embeddings for ~12 onboarding customers in EU+APAC. A handful are high-touch. We need a short status update to send now, + an RCA summary for follow-up. Who can draft?

maria_cs: can you post the impacted list? i'll triage renewals/high-risk ones and draft targeted lines.

olivia_csm: uploading list to the shared drive now (link in thread). top three are flagged renewal-risk. goal: send a transparent status email now, then 2pm PT office hours invite for impacted customers, and offer a 1-week credit if their production ingest failed.

ajay_se: root cause summary (short) — upstream batch worker that dedups embeddings hit a race when S3 manifest writes retried; this caused a backlog + timeouts in the ingestion pipeline for certain multi-file imports. fix deployed at 14:05 UTC with catch-up job; rate of processing back to normal but backlog still draining.

leo_ops: confirm: no data loss, just delayed indexing. KV: we replayed jobs, and can prioritize top 3 accounts. logs: `ingest-worker: warn retry manifest write 503 -> eventually success` .

sam_support: thanks — i'll open tickets for each customer with ETA and assign CSMs. Can we get a one-pager rcA to paste into tickets?

olivia_csm: drafting status note — please review: 
```
Hi <Customer Name>,

Quick update: we experienced a delay affecting embedding ingestion between 13:40–14:05 UTC that impacted some multi-file imports. We're sorry for the disruption. No data was lost; we have deployed a fix and are replaying queued jobs. Most customers will be fully indexed within 2–6 hours; we will keep you posted.

What we are doing: prioritizing impacted tenants, offering a complimentary 1-week credit for affected ingest windows, and hosting an office hours session at 2pm PT to walk through any questions.

Next steps: we will follow up with a short RCA within 48 hours. If you'd like earlier remediation or a manual priority replay, let us know and we will escalate.

— Olivia (Customer Success)
```

maria_cs: looks good. add: "if this impacts your launch timeline, reply and we'll assign a dedicated engineer and fast-track replay." for the renewal-risk accounts, i want the credit language softened: "we can offer account credit and hands-on support".

ajay_se: suggest adding a one-sentence root cause line: "Cause: transient retries on manifest writes in the ingestion worker led to queuing and delayed processing." keep it non-technical for end users.

leo_ops: also include a small note for sensitive customers: "we can provide an export of ingestion logs for your audit team on request."

olivia_csm: updated draft below for sign-off — will send in 10 mins unless objections: 
```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We wanted to let you know about a temporary delay that affected embedding ingestion for a subset of customer imports between 13:40–14:05 UTC. No data was lost; we deployed a fix and are replaying queued jobs now. We expect most tenants to be fully processed within 2–6 hours.

What we're doing: prioritizing impacted accounts, offering account credit and hands-on support, and hosting an office hours session at 2pm PT to address questions or manual replays. If this impacts your launch timeline, reply and we'll assign a dedicated engineer.

Cause (brief): transient retries on manifest writes in the ingestion worker caused queued jobs to back up.

We'll follow up with a detailed RCA within 48 hours. If you need logs for compliance, tell us and we will provide them.

Thanks — Olivia
```

sam_support: approved. i'll create tickets + templates and tag csms.

maria_cs: i'll send the individualized emails for the three renewal-risk accounts and add: "we value your partnership — if you'd like a quick call to walk through mitigations, we'll prioritize scheduling."

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-289 created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-289 — status: mitigated, severity: P2, notes: backlog draining, customers being notified.

olivia_csm: final action items: 1) sam: create tickets + shared template (10m) 2) maria: send targeted emails to flagged accounts (20m) 3) ajay/leo: prepare 48h RCA draft and deliver to me for review by EOD. i'll post the outgoing customer thread in #customer-status-log after send.

ajay_se: ack — RCA outline started.

leo_ops: will prioritize the top-3 replays now.

olivia_csm: thanks team. will post sent copy and track feedback. please drop any customer replies here so we can coordinate fast responses. :pray:
